conventions.convention: ANOVA components use real Borel L² functions on [0,1)^d, normalized base-b Haar contrasts, nonempty coordinate subsets, and nonnegative scale indices.
A (λ,t,m,d)-net has n=λb^m entries, counted with multiplicity, and exactly λb^t entries in each half-open elementary interval of total depth m−t; 1≤λ<b.

Input coordinates use terminating expansions when two base-b expansions exist. Nested scrambling indexes permutations by input prefixes, shares each node permutation across points, and uses independent families across coordinates.
Independent full-set randomizations are independent copies of the entire point array; points within a copy need not be independent. Point count n and replicate count R are separate.
The studentized limit assumes AC, fixed data and rule, positive finite replicate variance, and R→∞; the quotient receives any fixed value when its estimated variance is zero.
The sharp zero-net bound assumes Countable Choice and b≥max(d,2); the smooth rate fixes b,d,t,λ and assumes continuity of every nonempty mixed coordinate derivative.

load_bearing.statement: Assume Countable Choice. For fixed input points and their nested uniform scramble, every real Borel f∈L² satisfies Var(Î_n)=n⁻¹Σ_{u,κ}Γ_{u,κ}σ²_{u,κ}(f), with Γ defined by the stated ordered-pair products of Υ.
Assume Countable Choice. The stated contrast products together with 1 form a complete orthonormal family in real L²([0,1)^d), and Var(f(U))=Σ_{u≠∅,κ}σ²_{u,κ}(f).
Assume Countable Choice. For a (λ,t,m,d)-net, Γ_{u,κ}=0 if |κ|+|u|≤m−t; otherwise |Γ_{u,κ}|≤λb^{t+|u|−1}≤λb^{t+d−1}.
Assume Countable Choice. For a (0,m,d)-net in base b≥max(d,2), every gain satisfies Γ_{u,κ}≤(b/(b−1))^{min(m,d−1)}.
Assume Countable Choice and the stated continuous mixed derivatives. Then σ²_{u,κ}(f)≤4^{|u|}(b−1)^{|u|}M_u²b^{−2|κ|}.
For a marginally uniform randomized point array, with no independence assumption among its points, every Borel f∈L¹ gives an integrable estimator with E[Î_n(f)]=∫f.

The base-b digits of one uniform variable are mutually independent uniform digits; the stated deterministic reindexing supplies countably many independent uniform variables and hence independent uniform permutations.

concerns.concern: F2 attributes the formula 'Υ_{ij,q,k}=(b−1)⁻¹(b 1_{same prefix of length k+1}−1_{same prefix of length k})' to def-nested-uniform-scramble. That definition contains the scrambling procedure but does not define Υ. The exact formula is in the Statement of lem-rqmc-scrambled-net-variance-identity, already cited as F1. The calculation is supported, but F2 identifies the wrong supplier.

seams_checked.note: Checked the prerequisite page and def-star-discrepancy-and-digital-net against the RQMC definitions. Both use finite ordered multisets with multiplicities, half-open elementary intervals, and the same (t,m,d)-net counts. Setting λ=1 recovers the prerequisite definition. The deterministic page makes no randomization or construction-specific rate claim; the RQMC page supplies marginal uniformity, scrambling, and the additional hypotheses for its variance results.
